reason: I would download it because it is free and I do want to know what is happening in Tirana, but I would not actually join or pay for anything yet. Scrolling a feed is one thing; walking alone into a yoga class or a party full of strangers from an app is another, and by the end of the month I don't have 700 Lek spare anyway.
objection: Showing up alone. Seeing a list of names of who else is going does not tell me if these are people I'd be comfortable with, and nobody there knows me.
would_change_my_mind: If I could see that someone I already know from my WhatsApp groups is going, or join as part of a small newcomers group so I am not arriving alone, I would try one free event first and maybe buy a ticket later.
